category_title: Students with learning difficulties and attention issues who seek teacher approval and are easily distracted
scenario_title: Math intervention on digital device with environmental distractions
minimal_context: The student is using a Nintendo DS to solve addition, subtraction, and multiplication problems in a classroom setting.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please start the x20 session on the Nintendo DS and work on the addition and multiplication problems.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks up to make eye contact) I'm going to use my fingers to count for this addition problem.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Makes eye contact again) The multiplication and large numbers are really hard. I need to get the counters.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Drops the counters and turns away from the Nintendo DS to watch the rest of the classroom) What are those people doing over there?

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please start the x20 session on the Nintendo DS and work on the addition and multiplication problems.

STUDENT: (Looks up to make eye contact) I'm going to use my fingers to count for this addition problem.

TUTOR: Okay, continue.

STUDENT: (Makes eye contact again) The multiplication and large numbers are really hard. I need to get the counters.

TUTOR: Keep trying.

STUDENT: (Drops the counters and turns away from the Nintendo DS to watch the rest of the classroom) What are those people doing over there?

task.content: Solving addition, subtraction, multiplication and large numbers on the x20 session of the Nintendo DS
task.learning_goal: recognising numbers, recognising maths symbols, matching maths symbols, verbalising correct answers, writing single and double digit numbers, using tools (calculator, manipulative, etc.) to solve maths problems, and solving single digit addition, subtraction and multiplication problems

context.environment: Classroom setting with People and objects around him
context.materials: Nintendo DS, counters, rulers, number lines, and finger counting
context.social_setting: Teacher present for approval and eye contact
context.time_context: Middle to final stages of the intervention period

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When People and objects around him occasionally distracted him
related_quotes: People and objects around him occasionally distracted him

behavior_patterns.condition: When struggling with addition, subtraction, multiplication and large numbers
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: sought approval and would make eye contact with his teacher
related_quotes: He sought approval and would make eye contact with his teacher
